description: With news about the OnePlus 16 and the iQOO 16 headed to India at unusually high prices. We take a closer look at the two gamer-oriented smartphones which are equipped to compete, with large vapour-cooling chambers, top-of-the-line chipsets and high-capacity batteries.
title: OnePlus 16 vs iQOO 16: Which Gaming Flagship Should You Buy in India?

description: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion and Realme P4 Power 5G were launched in India earlier this year, competing in the sub-Rs. 35,000 price range. The Motorola Edge 70 Fusion sports the signature Motorola design, with a curved rear panel and a square-shaped camera module. The handset ships with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. The phone sports a 6.8-inch Super HD (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) Extreme AMOLED display, with up to a 144Hz refresh rate, 450 ppi pixel density, and up to 5,200 nits peak brightness. The Realme P4 Power 5G features a unique rear panel, sporting a square-shaped camera island and a horizontal pattern next to the deco. The smartphone boasts a 6.8-inch 1.5K 4D Curve+ HyperGlow display, with up to a 144Hz refresh rate, up to 6,500 nits of peak brightness, and 1.07 billion colours.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion vs Realme P4 Power 5G: Which One Should You Buy?

description: Jio's family postpaid plans start at Rs. 449 per month, while Vi's start at Rs. 751 per month. Airtel's family plan pricing includes Rs. 749, Rs. 1,049, Rs. 1,249, Rs. 1,449 and Rs. 1,799. Here, we compare the family postpaid plans offered by Jio, Airtel, and Vi in India.
title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: Best Family Postpaid Plans Compared

description: The mid-range smartphone segment has plenty of options for buyers who want a large battery, a high-refresh-rate display, and capable cameras, without entering flagship-level territory in terms of pricing. The Poco X8 and Redmi Turbo 5 are two such offerings from Xiaomi's smartphone portfolio. The handsets, however, take different approaches. While the Poco X8 prioritises battery capacity and a larger screen, the Redmi model offers a more powerful processor and faster charging.
title: Poco X8 vs Redmi Turbo 5: Which Is Better?

description: The Logitech MX Master 4 Creator Edition includes a Haptic Sense Panel for customisable feedback and an Actions Ring button that provides shortcuts to tools across different applications. Its MagSpeed scroll wheel supports speeds of up to 1,000 lines per second, while connectivity options include Bluetooth and a USB Type-C receiver. Logitech has also updated the wireless system with a new radio chip and an optimised antenna. The limited-edition mouse is currently listed at a discounted price on Amazon and Flipkart.
title: Logitech MX Master 4 Creator Edition With Customisable Controls, Haptic Feedback Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Subscribers can retain their mobile numbers after losing a phone by blocking the SIM and requesting a replacement from their existing operator. Jio customers can suspend a lost SIM by calling 1800-889-9999, while Airtel, Vi and BSNL users can contact their operators or visit a store. The missing handset can also be blocked through Sanchar Saathi using its IMEI number and a police complaint. Replacement requests require identity verification, and SMS services remain restricted for 24 hours after SIM re-issuance.
title: How to Get a Replacement SIM With the Same Number After Losing Your Phone

description: Smartphone users who have lost their handset can remotely block it using the IMEI number via the Sanchar Saathi app or online portal. There are also multiple prerequisites you need to complete before filing a request to block your phone using the IMEI number via the Sanchar Saathi mobile app or portal. First, you must file a police report and get the FIR copy of the lost or stolen mobile handset. You must also get a duplicate SIM or a reissued SIM card for the lost mobile phone number for OTP verification. Moreover, you need to have a valid identity card, like Aadhaar, handy, along with the ID number to fill out the form. If you want to file a request to remotely block your phone, you need to have the invoice for the device and a digital copy of it. Lastly, you need to get the IMEI numbers for the lost handset, usually printed on the invoice or on the back of the box.
title: Lost Your Phone? How to Block Its IMEI Using Sanchar Saathi

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra was recently launched in India, replacing the Tab S11 Ultra as the tech giant's latest flagship tablet. The new Tab S12 series device stays true to Samsung's DNA, keeping things simple yet premium. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, the tablet is powerful enough to meet most users' professional needs. The display quality is also top-notch, along with the best-in-class quad-speaker setup. However, the steep pricing can make you think twice before buying it. Moreover, the battery life also fails to meet expectations.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Review: Premium in Every Way, Including the Price
